title: Container image inventory (ADR-0010 G8 = A, task V07)
description: Static facts read from container image ARCHIVES supplied as run inputs. The only image source this schema can represent is a supplied archive file named by a run-relative path and its sha256: there is no field for a registry, a pull, a resolved tag, a container id, a start time or any other runtime observation, so a registry pull or a container start cannot be recorded, let alone implied. An image reference in a manifest is not an input. Cross-record rules live in appsec-review-process/container_mobile_binary_contracts.py.

job_id.description: The one node that may publish this result.

attempt_id.description: The node attempt; equals tool-results.json, coverage.json and the probe receipt.

images.description: One record per supplied archive. Empty exactly when the node is SKIPPED.
